name: Pirate
title: The Drowned Captain
description: A swaggering duelist. Chain cutlass strikes, fire your flintlock, and laugh at danger with a swig of rum.

cutlass.name: Cutlass
cutlass.description: Three-hit combo with a sweeping finisher.

flintlock.name: Flintlock
flintlock.description: A devastating close-quarters shot with real recoil.

roll.name: Roll
roll.description: A responsive directional roll with brief protection and eased recovery.

name: Samurai
title: The Crimson Ronin
description: A fearless, deliberate swordsman. Measured katana cuts and precise archery become a single moment of overwhelming force.

cutlass.name: Katana
cutlass.description: Measured katana combo with medium reach.

flintlock.name: Bow & Arrow
flintlock.description: A precise, fast arrow fired in the camera-facing direction.

roll.name: Dodge
roll.description: A buffered directional step through danger with a brief untargetable window.

drink.name: Iaijutsu
drink.description: An empowered draw-cut through a wide area, surrounded by crimson energy.

name: Ninja
title: The Violet Ghost
description: An elusive operative built for decisive elimination. Fast short-katana cuts, spreading shuriken, and sudden bursts of movement.

flintlock.name: Shuriken
flintlock.description: Throw five ninja stars in a tight fan.

roll.name: Ninja Dash
roll.description: A fast directional dash with brief evasion and a readable energy trail.

drink.name: Anbu Dance
drink.description: For 10s, katana hits may execute ordinary foes. Bosses take bonus damage.

name: Mage
title: The Astral Savant
description: An elegant caster wielding concentrated arcane force. Burst nearby foes with the staff, send energy from the wand, and blink away.

cutlass.name: Arcane Pulse
cutlass.description: One powerful staff blast in a limited area ahead.

flintlock.name: Energy Bolt
flintlock.description: Send a luminous magic projectile downrange.

roll.name: Blink
roll.description: Blink in your movement direction, stopping safely at solid cover.

drink.name: Overflow
drink.description: For 10s, both magical attacks cast in rapid succession.

name: Knight
title: The Iron Vow
description: A brave defender with an iron heart. Broad sword sweeps and a forceful shield turn steadfast defense into renewed attack.

cutlass.name: Broadsword
cutlass.description: Wide melee sweeps with a powerful final swing.

flintlock.name: Shield Bash
flintlock.description: Tap to bash. Hold to block incoming frontal projectiles.

roll.name: Short Dash
roll.description: A quick protected reposition with eased recovery into movement.

drink.name: Knight’s Code
drink.description: Prototype rule: 8s resilience; blocks empower the next sword strike.

name: Dragoon
title: The Azure Lancer
description: An elegant aerial fighter. Pierce from a distance, descend lance-first, then backflip clear before the dust settles.

flintlock.name: Leap
flintlock.description: Leap forward and slam down from above.

roll.name: Back Flip
roll.description: Backflip away from your facing with a smooth hips-centered rotation.

drink.name: Dragon Leap
drink.description: For 10s, Leap and Back Flip have no cooldown. Actions still take time.

name: Magic Swordsman
title: The Moonblade
description: A mysterious warrior with an oversized magical claymore. Substantial sword swings become immense, piercing waves of energy.

flintlock.name: Energy Wave
flintlock.description: A large, long-range blade wave pierces every enemy in its path.

roll.name: Dash Strike
roll.description: Dash in your movement direction and finish with the existing sweeping strike.

drink.name: Final Strike
drink.description: For 10s, energy waves have no cooldown beyond their cast animation.

name: Ranger
title: The Verdant Watch
description: An agile master of the greatbow. Alternate decisive shots with rapid volleys, leaping into the perfect firing line.

cutlass.name: Power Arrow
cutlass.description: A fast, powerful arrow fired with precision.

flintlock.name: Rapid Arrow
flintlock.description: Release four arrows in rapid succession.

roll.name: Fast Leap
roll.description: Leap in your movement direction; with no input, leap forward. Evade while airborne.

drink.name: Rain
drink.description: Rapid Arrow has no cooldown for a prototype 10s duration; volleys still take time.

name: Explorer
title: The Gilded Wayfarer
description: A courageous adventurer wielding twin blades. Rapid cuts and whirling attacks meet a hook shot that pulls you into the action.

cutlass.name: Twin Blades
cutlass.description: A rapid dual-wield combo that alternates both blades.

flintlock.name: Spin Attack
flintlock.description: Whirl in a complete circle to cut nearby enemies.

roll.name: Hook Shot
roll.description: Face a nearby foe or gold anchor and hook toward it. No target consumes no cooldown.

drink.name: Blood Lust
drink.description: All attacks become guaranteed 2× super critical hits for a prototype 8s.

name: Master Thief
title: The Smiling Ember
tagline: A little smoke. A lot of trouble.
description: An easygoing powerhouse with a huge smoke pipe. Catch attacks in a block, unleash stored fire, or duck and swing from below.

cutlass.name: Pipe Strikes
cutlass.description: Heavy pipe swings; Get Down changes these to low sweeping attacks.

flintlock.name: Pipe Block
flintlock.description: Hold to block and fill the meter. At full meter, tap to unleash fire. Disabled when lowered.

roll.name: Get Down
roll.description: Smoothly enter a low stance to avoid projectiles and use low strikes; press again to stand.

drink.name: Grand Smoke
drink.description: Provisional name: for 10s the pipe grows to 3× size, gains reach, and adds Fire.
